recipes.name: Hors D'oeuvres Sandwich inspired by Back to School
ingredients: filo dough (or store bought puff pastry)
instructions: For the Deviled Eggs
Start by steaming the eggs for 15 minutes and placing them into an ice bath immediately after. - eggs
Peel, cut in half and separate the yolks from the eggs. - eggs

To the yolks, add in the mayo, white vinegar, grain mustard, onion powder, and celery salt. Mix together. - 2 tbsp mayonnaise - 1 tbsp white vinegar - 1 tsp grain mustard - onion powder - celery salt - eggs
Optionally scoop mixture into a piping bag and pipe into the center of eggs, or scoop into eggs via a spoon. - For the Deviled Egg
Sprinkle with paprika and refrigerate until ready to use. - paprika
For the Meatball
In a large bowl, mix together ground beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, and spices. - ground beef - breadcrumbs - eggs - spices
Roll into individual balls and place on a wire rack set in a baking sheet. - For the Meatball
Bake at 375°F for 15-20 minutes. - For the Meatball
Toss meatballs into the desired sauce and place on the stovetop for 45 minutes. - For the Meatball
For the Spanakopita
Start by sauteing spinach in hot butter. - spinach
Once wilted, add in crushed garlic cloves and saute until shrunken. - 2 ½ garlic cloves crushed
If still too large, dump out onto a cutting board and chop to the desired size.
Add in chopped dill and feta cheese. - 2 tbsp dill chopped - ½ cup feta
Lightly butter and stack the filo dough. Slice into 3” wide 12” long segments. - filo dough (or store bought puff pastry) - melted butter
Place 2 Tbsp of filling to the top. Fold into a triangle. - For the Spanakopita Filling - filo dough (or store bought puff pastry)
Preheat the oven to 375°F. Brush the top of the triangles with melted butter. - melted butter
Bake for 20-25 minutes.
For the Sandwich Assembly
Slice the desired bread in half, scooping out half of the bread from each slice. - bread loaf of choice
Add in the meatballs, top with spanakopita, and deviled eggs. - bread loaf of choice - For the Meatball - For the Spanakopita Filling - For the Deviled Egg
Slice and enjoy.
